label: DLP 3D-printed 1x2 Y-branch splitter, PFeBSe/PMMA 5 % v/v core on PMMA substrate, 30 mm, 635 nm
core_material: PMMA acrylate resin doped with 5 % v/v PFeBSe conjugated copolymer solution (n 1.515 at 635 nm, value taken from the authors' ref. [10]), DLP 3D-printed (Anycubic Photon Ultra, 405 nm source, 0.05 mm layers)
cladding: printed pristine PMMA substrate (n 1.491 at 635 nm, ref. [10]) below, splitter fixed in a substrate groove with a thin UV-cured PMMA resin layer; no upper cladding described
notes: Multimode guide (hundreds of modes, p.2 Sec. II). Printed device: 30 mm long, arms 2 mm apart (p.2 Sec. III, "as shown in Figure 2"); Fig. 2 (p.3) is the CAD model sliced for printing (p.2 Sec. III). Fig. 2 end view: the 2.00 label spans the two arm centres, the 1.00 label spans the edges of one output arm (arm width entered), the 0.50 label spans the substrate top to the start of the rounded arm top (straight sidewall height, not a core thickness; not entered). The RSoft 2D simulation model is 33 mm long with 800 um arms, 2 mm centre-to-centre arm separation and a 9.5 deg angle between the arms at the branch tip (p.2 Sec. II; angle has no splitter parameter); p.3 Sec. IV calls the input guide cross-section diameter about 1 mm. Core and cladding indices are cited from ref. [10] (notes only). Fab: first-person 'our fabrication process' (p.2 Sec. III) with all authors at Fed. Univ. of Technology - Parana; that org is missing from the registry, so fab is empty (see report). Facility: use of the Multi-Foton facility of UTFPR acknowledged (p.4), missing from the registry. ITA / CTA thanked for the RSoft simulation package (not a fabrication facility). Not entered: expected minimum excess loss 6 dB for 30 mm (p.3-4; computed from the 0.1 dB/mm the authors cite from their ref. [10], rule 3); 6.8 dB of ref. [11] (other work); Fig. 1 BPM result (no number).
